Title: Our story
Body HTML:
We founded Everword because we noticed a gap in the world of gifting. You could either buy impersonal fine jewelry with an astronomical markup, or affordable pieces that tarnished before the next season. We wanted to create a space where you could find timeless, accessible luxury designed specifically to honor the people and milestones that matter most.

Our Philosophy

We don’t just sell jewelry; we craft wearable memories. Every piece in our collection is guided by three core principles:

  • Intention. From custom-engraved bars to birth month botanicals, our designs are blank canvases for your personal history.
  • Endurance. We utilize highly resilient materials — stainless steel and radiant 18K gold finishes — so your pieces can be lived in daily and beautifully stand the test of time.
  • Experience. We believe the magic of a gift begins before it is even worn, which is why every Everword piece arrives in our signature, presentation-ready packaging.

Crafted for Your Chapters

Whether you are celebrating a quiet victory, honoring a memory that will never fade, or simply reminding someone of their worth, we are here to help you mark the occasion.

Welcome to Everword. Beautifully crafted pieces for every chapter of your story.

For Faye.

Title: Materials
Body HTML:
We'd rather say this here than let you discover it when the box opens.

Metal

Our name necklaces are polished stainless steel, or stainless steel finished in 18K yellow gold. Our stone-set pendants — the Love Knot, the Pavé Halo, the Interlocking Hearts and the Halo Solitaire — are finished in 14K white gold or 18K yellow gold. Those are finishes over steel. Nothing here is solid gold, and we don’t describe it as solid gold anywhere. Steel is the reason these pieces survive daily wear, showers and sleeves far better than plated brass.

The finish available is listed on each product page, because it genuinely differs by piece.

Stones

Set stones are cubic zirconia, not diamonds. Birthstones are coloured crystal. Cubic zirconia is cut and polished like a gemstone and reads brilliantly in daylight; it is simply not a diamond, and we won’t imply otherwise.

Chains

Most pieces come on an adjustable 16–18″ cable chain with a 9 mm lobster clasp. Some keepsakes use a fine box chain; the four-sided bar uses a 16–22″ snake chain so it turns as it hangs; the Graduation Cap sits on 18–20″, and the Name Charm necklace on 16–24″. Chain type and length are listed on every product page.

Watches

The Open-Work is an automatic movement — no battery, wound by wearing it — with a skeleton dial, hardened mineral glass and a genuine black leather band, water resistant to 3 ATM. The Chronograph is 316L stainless steel with a copper dial and a quartz movement, also 3 ATM. The Wooden Watch is a 45 mm sandalwood case on leather with a Japanese quartz movement and is IPX-4 splash resistant only — keep it away from swimming and showers. All three have an engravable caseback and arrive in a mahogany-style luxury box with an LED.

Sensitive skin

Stainless steel is what most people with reactive skin get on best with, but we have not had nickel content confirmed to us in writing, so we won’t call these pieces hypoallergenic.

Title: The message card
Body HTML:
Every order includes a printed card, at no extra cost. It sits in the lid of the box, above the piece, so it's read before the jewellery is lifted out.

Cards are printed square and sized to sit in the lid of the box. Your message is set in the middle, where the chain and pendant don't cover it.

Writing it

You can write your own, or start from one of ours and change it. Choose the occasion on the product page and we'll suggest a few lines that fit — a birthday reads differently from a memorial, and the suggestions change accordingly.

Around 200 characters sits comfortably. Shorter is usually better; the best cards we've seen say one specific thing rather than three general ones.

Before we print

The preview on the product page is the proof. What you see there is what we print — there's no second approval step, and we won't email you anything to sign off. Read it once more before you add to bag; spelling is the one thing we can't undo.

Title: Returns
Body HTML:
Everything we sell is made after you order it, and every order carries a card printed with your words. That means none of it can be put back on a shelf and sold to somebody else — so we can't accept a return simply because it wasn't wanted. We'd rather say that plainly here than at the point you're asking.

If it's faulty, damaged, or not what you submitted

We’ll remake it and send the replacement free of charge. That covers damage in transit, a fault we should have caught, the wrong item, artwork that isn’t what you submitted, and a parcel that has sat in transit for an unreasonable length of time. You won’t need to post anything back to us.

Film it, don’t photograph it. A short video showing the piece and the packaging is what opens a remake — still photographs on their own aren’t enough. Send it within 30 days of delivery, or 55 days if you’re outside the US.

Typos

Email us the moment you spot one. Pieces go into production quickly, so we can't promise to catch it — but if yours hasn't started we'll correct it free of charge, and if it has, we'll remake it at our cost rather than yours. Once per order.

What we won't produce

We won't print or cut personalisation that's unlawful, infringes someone else's trade mark, or is abusive. If we decline on those grounds we'll refund you in full.

Title: Jewellery care
Body HTML:
• Remove it when bathing or swimming
  • Avoid abrasives and household cleaners
  • Put it on after perfume, lotion and hairspray — never before
  • Store it in its box, away from damp
  • Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth

Why it matters

These are finished pieces rather than solid gold, so the finish is the part that wears. Kept dry and stored separately, it lasts years. Worn in a chlorinated pool and left in a damp bathroom, it won't.

What we collect

Your name, email address, shipping address and order details when you buy something. The personalisation you enter — names, dates, messages — because we can't make the piece without it. Payment is handled by our payment processor; we never see or store your full card number.

Why we collect it

To make and ship your order, to email you about that order, and to answer you when you contact us. If you join our newsletter we'll email you about once a month, and you can unsubscribe from any of those emails.

Who we share it with

Our manufacturing and fulfilment partner, so they can make and post your order. Our payment processor. Our email provider. Nobody else, and we don't sell your data.

How long we keep it

What we're working towards

Title: The Atelier
Body HTML:
At Everword, we do not pull finished personalized pieces from a shelf. Every custom necklace, engraved bar, and bespoke keepsake begins as a blank canvas, waiting for your specific chapter to be written. The journey of your gift starts the exact moment you place your order.

Shaped to Your Story

Your words dictate the physical form of the jewelry. When you design a custom name necklace, the typography is precision-scaled to your exact spelling and capitalization. A three-letter name and an eleven-letter name are physically different architectural structures, each one cut from a single sheet and hung to sit at the collarbone. What you type is exactly what is cut — a true, unedited reflection of your sentiment.

Precision Craftsmanship

State-of-the-art precision cutting and engraving technology brings your design to life. Working exclusively with durable, everyday materials — stainless steel, radiant 18K gold finishes, and clear cubic zirconia — every piece is crafted with modern endurance in mind. For our wooden timepieces, the natural grain dictates the design, ensuring no two watches will ever be identical.

The Uncompromising Standard

We believe that a gift meant to mark a milestone must be flawless. Before any piece leaves the facility, it is inspected. A piece that does not pass is not shipped — it goes back and is made again, which adds about two days. This uncompromising standard takes a little extra time, but it ensures your gift is worthy of the occasion.

The Art of the Reveal

The magic of an Everword gift is in the presentation. Your custom message card is printed alongside your jewelry and placed face-up in the lid of our Signature Everword Box, or your chosen Luxe upgrade. It is intentionally designed to be the very first thing they see when they lift the lid — ensuring your words are felt before the jewelry is even worn.

The Journey Home

Because true intentionality cannot be rushed, your piece takes three to five business days to cut, plate, inspect and package, and production runs on weekdays. Then it ships, and delivery within the United States is a further two to five business days.

Title: The Everword World
Body HTML:
A personalised piece has a strange property: it is worth a great deal to exactly one person and almost nothing to anyone else. That is the opposite of how jewellery usually works, and it is the whole reason this brand exists.

So the things we make are not aimed at an aesthetic. They are aimed at a moment — the graduation, the first year, the one that is missing from the table. The metal is the durable part. The words are the gift.

What you will find here

Names cut in script. Dates engraved down the side of a bar. A stone for a birth month. Three watches with something on the caseback. And a printed card in the lid of every box, because the object on its own has never been the point.

What you will not

Diamonds we are calling diamonds when they are cubic zirconia. Solid gold we are calling solid gold when it is a finish over steel. Sale prices that were never the real price.
